title: Serverless & AWS Lambda
summary: What serverless means on AWS, then AWS Lambda in depth: Lambda versus EC2, runtimes and container images, pricing, limits, concurrency, throttling, asynchronous retries and destinations, cold starts, provisioned concurrency and SnapStart. Also CloudFront Functions versus Lambda@Edge, Lambda in a VPC, RDS Proxy, invoking Lambda from RDS and Aurora, and RDS event notifications.
